pages.text: Bram: $(italic)Boards first. Wheel second. There is no third.$()$(br2)$(bold)Andesite Alloy$() is the whole of the first tier: two andesite, two iron nuggets, in a two-by-two. Q13 asks for $(bold)8$(). Bram's crate for the mill race carries $(bold)32$() more.
pages.title: The Mill

pages.text: Once the wheels turn, a Millstone or a Mixer over a Basin makes these in bulk and you never craft one by hand again.
The Millstone is the first thing the wheels drive. Grain in, flour out -- which is Q14, and Marnie's whole kitchen after it.

$(bold)One Water Wheel: 32 su per RPM, spinning at 8 RPM. 256 su.$()$(br2)Two wheels on the race is $(bold)512 su$(), which is exactly what Q16 asks for.$(br2)$(li)Millstone: 4 per RPM = $(bold)32 su$()$(li)Mechanical Saw: 4 = $(bold)32 su$()$(li)Mechanical Press: 8 = $(bold)64 su$()$(li)Mechanical Mixer: 4 = $(bold)32 su$()
pages.title: Stress, in plain numbers

pages.text: The four machines Act One gives you come to $(bold)160 su$() against $(bold)512$(). You will not run out. If the Stressometer goes red anyway, something you forgot about is spinning.$(br2)Act Two adds an $(item)Encased Fan$() at $(bold)16 su$(). Still fine.

$(bold)The gate:$() the Water Wheel in this valley is built with $(item)Seasoned Oak Boards$(). Green oak will not do it.$(br2)Marnie's oven makes them -- $(bold)32 boards$() come out of Q15 and go straight into Bram's crate. Bram cannot build the wheel until the boards are dry. That is the oven, and that is you.
pages.title: Who holds the gate
